purpose: Repeat the unchanged ten-candidate timing-closure pilot after a synthetic infrastructure-stability gate, separating allowlisted host/tool I/O failures from scientific measurement failures.

v1_boundary.status: irreversible protocol failure and aborted pilot
v1_boundary.candidate_rule: Use all ten v1 manifest candidates in their original frozen order; rerun every candidate from scratch in v2, including candidates completed in v1.
v1_boundary.result_directory_changes: v2 uses a new empty results directory and never reads v1/results during execution

dependency_stability.guard_timing: before and after every synthetic or candidate Vivado process
dependency_stability.mismatch_action: classify as infrastructure, retain the attempted directory/ledger row, and apply only the bounded infrastructure retry rule

synthetic_stability_gate.pass_rule: All 12 consecutive first attempts must pass the unchanged full synth/opt/place/route/constraint flow; every pre/post dependency guard must match; no allowlisted infrastructure signature may appear.
synthetic_stability_gate.failure_rule: Any failed launch or dependency mismatch freezes a FAIL attestation and blocks every Study-2 candidate. A new campaign requires a new protocol version or explicit pre-candidate amendment retaining the failed campaign.

infrastructure_classification.outcome_independence: Classification may inspect process status, dependency hashes, stage code, and exact diagnostic text/path. It may not inspect WNS sign/value, closed status, candidate arm, family, old proxy, or rank.
infrastructure_classification.internal_tcl_signature: A failed measurement at synth/implementation stage whose stdout/stderr contains exactly an open/read failure for a path under the frozen Vivado scripts/rt/data dependency set, with no candidate/syntax/design-error denylist signature.
infrastructure_classification.retry_identity: candidate_id, RTL hash, module, clock, requested period, purpose, Tcl hash, dependency baseline, and all command arguments remain byte-for-byte/number-for-number identical
infrastructure_classification.exhaustion_action: ABORT_INFRASTRUCTURE for the whole v2 run; do not zero-score the candidate, do not continue to another candidate, and do not calculate the pilot gate

scientific_failure.rule: Any invalid measurement not independently allowlisted as infrastructure is retained once and handled by the original v1 zero-scored candidate failure rule.
scientific_failure.boundary_confirmation: The original one fresh confirmation at each bracket boundary remains a scientific reproducibility check, not an infrastructure retry.

stop_rules: Do not launch any Study-2 candidate until the v1 abort report, dependency baseline, v2 protocol manifest, unit tests, dry-run, and twelve-launch synthetic PASS attestation are frozen and validated.
Never read or cache v1 candidate closure outcomes in the v2 runner.
Do not change candidate order, periods, search bounds, thresholds, classifier allowlist, denylist, or retry count after any v2 candidate launch.
An exhausted infrastructure retry aborts the entire run without scientific scoring.
A non-infrastructure invalid measurement follows the original v1 scientific failure rule without a broad retry.
